# Phase 3b.2 ablation (dev; generated by `make gen-eval ARGS=ablation`)

Each arm changes one thing from 3b.1: A draft reasoning effort back to the provider default; B no first look; C first look with a tool-call cap of 10. Verify on. Levels: value (denominator, n questions). Differences: row minus reference, paired bootstrap 95% CI over questions scored in both (10,000 resamples, seed 20261003); * = the CI excludes 0. First-draft citation (a) failure is from the _off config (the same trajectory's first draft); lower is better. gold_all: share of runs that gathered or read every gold doc; gold_frac: mean fraction of gold docs gathered per run.
